gene_coefficients: arithmetic mean over all outer training fits
attributions: mean of fold-specific standardized feature times coefficient over held-out repeats
rescue_rule: y=1; mean delta >0.05; delta >0.05 in at least15 repeats; BH q<0.05
correction_rule: y=0; mean delta <-0.02; delta <-0.02 in at least15 repeats; BH q<0.05
wilcoxon_null: paired probability difference equals zero; greater for toxic, less for non-toxic
bh_family: all compounds within each variant/endpoint/cell before effect and stability filtering
